query_plan.query: What is the average capacity of UEFA Champions League venues?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate by venue, then compute the average capacity.
steps.query: Return all venues together with their capacities, with their venue id and venue name.

extra.sql_query: SELECT AVG(ucl_venues.capacity) AS avg_capacity FROM ucl_venues

s1.sql_query: SELECT ucl_venues.venue, ucl_venues.capacity, ucl_venues.name FROM ucl_venues
